about: THE UK SOURCE DOCUMENTS (26 Nov): the seven gov.uk PDFs the UK curriculum files cite, each kept as its text (pdftohtml -xml, one row per run of type: page, top, left, font size, bold 1/0, text), so tools/spec-read.js reads them with no network. `pdf` is the file read, `sha256` and `bytes` the PDF as downloaded on `fetched`, `text_sha256` the stored text (tools/spec-tree.js fails the build when the text and this disagree). Refresh with `node tools/spec-read.js --fetch uk` (needs pdftohtml). `layout`: the document's layout in layouts.json.
